This matrix is a working checklist, not a verdict. The reviewer supplies the verdict per row.
The package is intentionally conservative; reviewers are encouraged to push it further toward 'unvalidated' rather than less.
The presence of a test file in tests/ at the current base SHA is not, by itself, evidence of a passing test.

Phase 51F pins (engine-output golden, parity-core lock) are regression protection, not external validation. They pin the current model against drift; they do not validate the model against external truth. Phase 51G-1 did not modify any parity-core file; the four locked files are unchanged from a541d447.

Phase 51G-1 (POST /save-run golden characterization) is Agent A's characterization-only work, on main as of 2e41b24, and is part of the base state. Agent B does not own /save-run and did not touch any Phase 51G-1 file in this PR.
The matrix and the markdown documents it points at must be read together. The matrix alone is not a substitute for the markdown.
